measurable_scope: Observed point counts, axis/robust spans and board-referenced projected occupancy/hull descriptors only.
gaps: Board dimensions supplied by operator: 25 mm square, 18 mm marker, 7 by 10 DICT_4X4_50; independent printed-size uncertainty unavailable.
D405 metric gauge re-expressed from supplied board pitch; L515 effective depth gain is empirically fitted, not a confirmed native device unit; cross-camera transform is a research estimate.
No independently supported actual stem-base and very-tip pair.
Assistant image correspondence is not independent operator ground truth.
Held-flat ruler endpoint conventions/pose are not frozen in 3D.
No ruler width section established as global maximum width.
pose_policy: Exact accepted final ICP camera-to-reference transforms, never interpolated/pre-ICP bundle poses.
axis_definition: X follows gantry row; Y perpendicular in display plane; Z fitted-board display normal, not independently verified gravity.
projection_policy: Calibrated distorted source RGB; full-cloud 10mm self-occlusion and 12mm stereo foreground occlusion tolerances inherited from cleanup review; tolerances remain physical 10 mm / 12 mm after gauge correction.
